description: Which tickers were moving in the last day-trade session? The intraday lane: the names in motion, read in the context of the gate. The morning's day-trade state map: per-name intraday lights grid (price/RSI/MACD x 5m-1D), GO, FUEL vs anchor ETF, entry-window state and ROOM for 3 names plus 2 per cohort, with the cohort anchors and the reading guide. Day states decay in minutes, so this morning read is a schema/shape preview, not a trading input. Free sample: 3 names plus 2 per cohort, from the morning read.
name: get_day_board
